notes: Total 60 as published. The post names no starting cards beyond the objective (posted 'HDADTJ').

Tournament: 3–0 at both the 2000 Tulsa Grand Slam and the 2000 Texas State Championship per the description; filed under the Texas State hub (which already cites Matt Lush), the Tulsa GS result is in the player note.

'Shiny' marks foil cards (DLOTS, Jabba, U-3PO, one Vader's Saber, Visage); not part of the names. Posted 'DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'ECC Iggy' IG-88 With Riot Gun and 'ECC 4-LOM' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (Enhanced Cloud City); 'Brangus' Brangus Glee; 'Ghhk' Ghhhk; 'Oota-Goota Solo?' Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?; 'Hoth3rd Marker' Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker); the run-together 'Executor...', 'Tatooine...', 'Endor...' and 'JP...' names dested the matching sites; 'Executor' the Dagobah starship.
The author asks that the post not be counted for that month's Deck of the Month.
Battle Order, Resistance, Secret Plans, Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward (where listed) are the pre-Reflections III Effects (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
player_note: The post's description (7 May 2000) says: 'This deck went 3-0 in both the Tulsa GS and the Texas State Championships.' The strategy adds 'I dropped Crush and one Evader from this deck' after a friend's deck beat it, so the posted list may differ slightly from what was played.
